why: New async webhook-notification parser that older versions lack, so calling it there fails.
New config option that older versions reject as an unknown config property.
Types-only loosening to optional params; existing code is accepted unchanged.
Fixes the named `Stripe` export under Bun so it works as documented.
Generated update adds new params, fields and enum values (e.g. sunbit, managed_payments) that older types reject; it also changes some types such as pix setup_future_usage.
Async errors now carry preserved stack traces, so error stacks differ with no code change.
New type export; using it on older versions is a type error.
Restores file uploads that failed in v22, which the docs already describe as working.
New resource with create/retrieve plus new capabilities and payment methods that older versions lack.
A warning is now emitted when the response has a stripe-notify header; requests otherwise work as before.
New V2List and V2ListPromise types for v2 list endpoints; absent in older versions.
ESLint rule for the repo's own development, not observable by users.
Newly exported OAuth types; referencing them on older versions is a type error.
Nested param class types are newly accessible; older versions give a type error.
Path params are now URI-encoded, so the request URL sent for the same call changes.
Fixes V2ListIterator concurrency and empty-page handling to work as intended.
The user-agent header sent with requests now includes a source field.
Header number parsing now returns undefined instead of NaN for invalid values, correcting a bug.
Fixes CJS type exports so types resolve as documented.
Corrects a typing bug that wrongly allowed Stripe.ErrorType.StripeError as a runtime class.
Fixes type handling of shadowed namespaces reported as a bug.
The account ID path param is now URI-encoded, changing the URL sent for the same call.
Generated update removes stored_credential_usage from card payment details (type error) and makes Billing.CreditGrant.priority required, besides adding new fields and enum values.
Fixes TypeScript access to nested namespace types that should already have worked.
Removes Retry-After support that was unused, so there is no observable change.
Type-only change to HttpClient exports that accepts the same code.
Restores dropped public type exports (Stripe.StripeConfig, Stripe.HttpClient, etc.) that code could not reference in v22; older versions that dropped them reject usage.
Telemetry internals changed with no user-observable API change.
Error fields are now generated, with no observable change.
Removes proof_of_registration and Checkout line_items dynamic_tax_rates params (type errors), plus adds new resources and methods like Account.unreject.
Dependency bump of brace-expansion.
Types-only annotation for non-exhaustive enums that accepts the same code.
Module load now emits a plugin hint when CLAUDECODE or CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION env vars are set, changing output for existing code.
New methods to parse events without verification; older versions simply lack them.
New constant that users can read.
Serializing a discriminated union param with a missing or non-string discriminator now throws instead of skipping coercion.
New class for handling thin event notifications.
Turns an indefinite hang into a connection error when the server drops mid-response.
Removes cryptogram from PaymentAttemptRecord and PaymentRecord three_d_secure types, and adds new resource Billing.FeedbackOption with its methods.
Multipart boundary generation is not meaningfully observable to users.
Docstring update only.
Fixes serialization of coerced values like Decimal in GET and DELETE query params so they work as intended.
Hardening against malicious URLs, with no detail on what behavior changes for users.
Empty webhook secrets are now rejected with an error instead of being accepted.
